name: Cherrymon
main_effect:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] You may suspend 1 Digimon.
[Opponent's Turn] [Once Per Turn] When one of your opponent's Digimon attacks, if this Digimon is suspended, you may change the attack target to 1 of your Digimon with the [WG] trait.
source_effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your [WG] trait Digimon are played, you may Suspend 1 of your opponent's Digimon.
